title: Conditions on the Further Credit for Readings Taken from an Unwatched Controls System
content:
# Conditions on the Further Credit for Readings Taken from an Unwatched Controls System

**Condition 1.** Where an energy monitoring subscription the owner holds stands active and reads its data from the controls system, a further credit of one month of that subscription's own fee for each meter it covers is added to the credit on the plan under the Building Automation Service Plans, the readings it took from the unwatched system being unusable.

**Condition 2.** Where an energy monitoring subscription the owner holds stands active and reads its data from both the controls system and its own meters, half that further credit is added.

**Condition 3.** In every other case no further credit is added for the readings taken from the unwatched system.

**Condition 4.** The further credit is taken to two decimal places.

The subscription, its standing, the source its data is drawn from, the meters it covers and its own fee for each meter are read from the office's records of Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions held by that owner.

| Energy monitoring subscription standing active | The source its data is drawn from | Further credit |
|---|---|---|
| yes | the controls system | one month of that subscription's own fee for each meter it covers |
| yes | both the controls system and its own meters | half that further credit |
| yes | its own meters only | none |
| no | not read | none |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

An owner holding a subscription under the Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions standing active, covering 12 meters at 36 USD a meter a year and drawing its data from the controls system: one month of that fee is 3 USD a meter, so the further credit is 36.00 USD. Drawing its data from both the controls system and its own meters, it would be 18.00 USD.
